title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
summary: Calculate the sum of the minimum values for all possible contiguous subarrays in the given integer array, then return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Calculate the sum of the minimum values for all possible contiguous subarrays in the given integer array, then return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Sum the minimum of every nonempty contiguous subarray modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Count how many subarrays choose each element as their representative minimum.
Use a monotonic stack to find its previous and next stopping boundaries.
Tie direction assigns duplicate minima once, and every subarray has one assigned minimum.
editorial: Tie direction assigns duplicate minima once, and every subarray has one assigned minimum.

tests.explanation: The ten subarray minima sum to 17.
